audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed with their own whys: levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 were shipped as 'Ziggs' at 2/10 while every one of those whys says the stage is even, and the two item rows were 'Skill'/'Ziggs' under whys saying you pull ahead at first item and kill him in the sidelane with two.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere]; the whys agree row for row, and the matchup sits at 50.21% over 948 games, which a chart giving Ziggs four 2/10 stages cannot support.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 realigned in both layers with ratings.

audit.why: The real swing is your first crit item plus boots letting you close through his zoning; his own R at 6 adds range and burst but does not take the stage, which is what the chart now says.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge appeared everywhere with no cooldown and no mention that its damage is max-health based, Bouncing Bomb's cooldown was never given, Hexplosive Minefield had no number, and Short Fuse's empowered auto — the actual opener — was absent.
audit.why: Riot kit: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000 range, flagged percentHealth, and knocks Ziggs away too. Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850 range. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at 900 range. Short Fuse is an empowered basic attack whose cooldown drops each time he casts an ability, so his damage opens with an auto wind-up rather than a visible cast.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with those numbers and the Short Fuse tell.

edits.after: Satchel Charge is down 20s at rank 1 and knocks him away too — engage the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His Minefield is 16s flat — spin in the moment both W and E are spent.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Satchel takes a cut of your max health — armour is the wrong answer.
